about: The Next track (DEC-074): everything designed but not yet in the app. Current is what the app ships. Each item is a Proposal until the user approves it; implementation takes only Approved items. The app PR that builds an item promotes it: its styles move into the base, a replaced screen (or the screen a variant was an alternative to, if the variant wins) goes to the archive (never deleted), and the item is removed from this list. Items may belong to a feature (one rail row for all its screens); `open` says which screen the rail opens per platform.

items.title: Open lists look
items.summary: No boxes around content: groups separated by space and a heading, rows without dividers, selection as a tinted shape, no row menus. Phone Lists rows carry the editor's status edge (D1b). Styles in src/styles/next/; markup reads useNextLook(). Foldable not covered (stays Current).
items.source: Design reviews 2026-11-11 and 2026-11-12; user feedback 2026-11-12 and 2026-11-22

items.title: Roster Organizer
items.summary: An alternative Lists screen with an Organize panel: search, folders, game systems and tags over all saved rosters. Shown beside Lists on Next. Kept to refine (user 2026-11-22); dropped if refinement doesn't work. Still drawn in the Current look.
items.source: Former V2 release track

items.title: Desktop unit panel
items.summary: The unit editor can be docked as the roster editor's right panel, shown or hidden with the toolbar's panel toggle and resizable like the catalogue (300–560 px, 360 px at first), as the tablet's Unit details pane is. Shown, it follows the selected row; hidden, a unit opens in the dialog (the Current design, DEC-055). Gallery screens that draw the dialog start with the panel hidden.
items.source: User feedback 2026-11-22: horizontal space on desktop is cheap, keep the right panel as a user choice

items.title: A3 · Sources · Problems in words, each with its fix

features.title: Add-ons and variants
features.summary: Layers under their base in Sources (enable, order, problems with their fix), install with a requirement check, the roster open review, base updates and the roster's recorded data. One row in the rail for all its screens; the Layers (A3) workflow lists them.
